Just started using Copay as my primary wallet for all my devices (Linux/iOS) and it seems ok. I come from breadwallet/electrum and as I understand, Copay replaces the "mnemonic seed phrase" concept with the "copay backup" concept which also can be encrypted with a password. I don't know but it doesn't seem possible to import other wallets into Copay (anyway I didn't care about this, as this wallet it's truly cross-platform); but one thing I did noticed is that while I can send/receive XBT very fast, it has trouble sending via QR Scan to ChangeTip:

> Could not parse payment protocol error, illegal group end indicator for message....

So, what's your take on this wallet? Any other issues I should be aware of?
